20.title: Exercício extra B — Monte a frase com a preposição de lugar
20.note: Modelo: I / work / home / Mondays → I work from home on Mondays.

items.a: I work at the office on Tuesdays.

items.q: we / meet / the meeting room / Friday
items.a: We meet in the meeting room on Friday.

items.q: he / work / home / two days a week
items.a: He works from home two days a week.

items.q: the team / be / the office / now
items.a: The team is at the office now.
